name: Cold start of a 100 kW automotive PEM fuel-cell system from -30 C in an environment cabin (normal operation, on-load shutdown purge at 30 A, cold start with auxiliary heat)
plain_name: Start a full-size car fuel-cell power system after it has been frozen to -30 C
description: A full-power automotive PEMFC system (stack rated 100 kW at 1.4 A/cm2, up to 120 kW) is operated, purged on load at 30 A at shutdown, soaked and restarted from -30 C inside an environment cabin with auxiliary heating; cold start was achieved within 110 s.
keywords: Start a full-size car fuel-cell power system after it has been frozen to -30 C

sources.citation: Liu P., Xu S., Experimental Analysis of -30C Cold Start Process for an Automotive PEM Fuel Cell System, SAE Technical Paper 2022-01-0694 (2022), doi:10.4271/2022-01-0694

requirements.rationale: The system is cold-soaked and started from -30 C (243.15 K).
The system delivers electrical load (100 kW rated stack) during operation and start-up, so load cabling into the cabin is required.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
